purpose: A/B control for the as-of weather retrain (plan T0.3). The weather run must change ONLY the weather channel vs this config.

data.weather: old [4,22] Open-Meteo historical-forecast snapshot (lead-leaky) - the thing the A/B replaces

test_metrics._vs_classical_removed: The vs_classical block was dropped: it compared this model's in-game-state home_win Brier (0.15921, conditioned on live game state) against the pregame classical Brier (0.2733, conditioned on pregame info only). Different information sets, so the 41.74% 'improvement' is not a model comparison. Use extra_innings, where both are pregame-comparable: DL 0.06812 vs classical 0.0677 -- the DL head is marginally WORSE.

comparison_metric: phase1 best_val. Cross-phase losses are NOT comparable (different head composition), so the A/B must compare phase-for-phase.
notes: Run crashed once at Val E2 (transient DataLoader worker death, no OOM); relaunch survived the same point.

Every phase reaches best val within 1-7 epochs and then diverges (phase1 train-val gap goes -0.004 -> -0.193). At d_model=384/6 layers on 314,953 train samples the model saturates early, so a LARGER model is contraindicated; a size study should go down and/or up-regularize.

test_metrics regenerated 2026-08-30 from the saved checkpoint (not re-trained) after three eval defects were fixed: the hits clamp(0,4); scoring player heads on padding slots (y>=0 admits them because padding is stored as 0, not -1); and scoring the P(1+ event) HR/SB heads against COUNT targets with a p(1-p) baseline that is only valid for binary y.

The treatment arm ALSO contains a training-side fix (HR/SB focal-BCE targets are now binarised, game_transformer.py), so phase2/phase3 losses are no longer comparable to this control. phase1 best_val remains the A/B metric, which is what comparison_metric already designates -- phase1 trains game-level heads only, so the player-head fix cannot touch it.

Two heads had NO held-out metric at all before 2026-08-30: extra_innings (never computed) and the strikeout head (eval read all_targets['player_pitcher_k'], but the dataset emits 'player_so', so the isinstance guard skipped the block silently). Guarded by deep_learning/tests/test_eval_metric_coverage.py.

Skill scores vs the constant quote on this control: home_win BSS +0.362, yrfi +0.2597, extra_innings +0.2553. player_hr -0.860 and player_sb -1.414 RAW, but both carry real signal (AUC 0.640 / 0.713) and reach +0.026 / +0.038 after a 2-parameter Platt map fit on val; the raw heads are 3.5x/5.5x hot because focal loss is not a proper scoring rule. A calibration layer is required before quoting these two.
